exposure: Women with preexisting IHD who had undergone revascularization before pregnancy
Women with preexisting IHD who had not undergone revascularization before pregnancy
cohort: 117 pregnant women with ischemic heart disease (IHD) from 138 centers in 53 countries
finding: Women with IHD tolerate pregnancy relatively well, but there is a high rate of ischemic events, making them moderate- to high-risk pregnancies.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was the primary mode of delivery (55.8% in preexisting IHD, 84.6% in pregnancy-onset IHD).
